exposure: prenatal diagnosis of congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH)
prenatal diagnosis of transposition of great arteries (TGA)
cohort: Children with spina bifida, transposition of great arteries (TGA), congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH), or gastroschisis
finding: Prenatal diagnosis of the studied anomalies was not associated with improved outcomes and might be linked to increased detection of severe cases and lower gestational age at birth.
